render_back.render_back_text: Index determination discretion refers to discretion that may need to be exercised in relation to the Index and in relation to at least one index determination matter. Applicable matters include determination of the index universe and selection of index components, and other relevant decisions in relation to the Index. Strict rules govern the exercise of discretion and expert judgement. Any index determination discretion is to be exercised in accordance with those strict rules.
